name: APort Guardrails
description: Deterministic pre-action authorization via APort policy enforcement. Registers before_tool_call to block disallowed tools.

mode.description: local = guardrail script, api = APort API

apiKey.description: Optional. Prefer APORT_API_KEY env var; do not put ${APORT_API_KEY} in config (OpenClaw requires the var to exist).

failClosed.description: Block tool on guardrail error when true

allowUnmappedTools.description: If true (default), allow tools with no policy mapping (custom skills, ClawHub, etc.). Set to false to block unmapped tools for stricter security.

agentId.description: Optional hosted passport ID from aport.io (API fetches passport)

alwaysVerifyEachToolCall.description: Run fresh APort verify for each tool call

mapExecToPolicy.description: Map exec tool to system.command.execute policy
